account_deletion_requests_purge_after_su.name: account_deletion_requests_purge_after_suspend
account_deletion_requests_purge_after_su.value: "account_deletion_requests"."purge_eligible_at" IS NULL OR ("account_deletion_requests"."suspended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_deletion_requests"."purge_eligible_at" >= "account_deletion_requests"."suspended_at")

agency_billing_invoice_terms.name: agency_billing_invoice_terms
agency_billing_invoice_terms.value: ("agency_billing_accounts"."collection_method" = 'send_invoice' AND "agency_billing_accounts"."days_until_due" BETWEEN 1 AND 90) OR ("agency_billing_accounts"."collection_method" = 'charge_automatically' AND "agency_billing_accounts"."days_until_due" IS NULL)

agency_creator_links_acceptance_state.name: agency_creator_links_acceptance_state
agency_creator_links_acceptance_state.value: ("agency_creator_links"."status" <> 'accepted') OR ("agency_creator_links"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_creator_links"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

agency_creator_links_revocation_state.name: agency_creator_links_revocation_state
agency_creator_links_revocation_state.value: ("agency_creator_links"."status" <> 'revoked') OR ("agency_creator_links"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_creator_links"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

agency_license_allocations_grace_state.name: agency_license_allocations_grace_state
agency_license_allocations_grace_state.value: ("agency_license_allocations"."status" <> 'removal_scheduled') OR ("agency_license_allocations"."removal_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_license_allocations"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_license_allocations"."ends_at" > "agency_license_allocations"."removal_requested_at")
